The capital of Alaska is Juneau.

Juneau is located in Southeast Alaska and is the least accessible state capital by highway, being primarily dependent on air and sea transportation. It is the most extensive state capital by area and is noted for its natural environment, including the Chilkoot Range, Tongass National Forest, and Mendenhall Glacier.
The capital of Alaska is Juneau. It has been the seat of government since 1945 and remains the most significant city in Southeast Alaska.
